question: Which classes of semi-divine beings are included in this cosmic enumeration?
premises: Kinnaras, Yakshas, and Nagas are included
inference: The enumeration extends to Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas.
plain_english: Gandharvas, Kinnaras, Yakshas, Nagas, and Vidyadharas, O beloved.
